roles.identity: Fact Profile logical object, immutable version root, exact Fact Cut root, and named-ref resolution receipt
roles.sourceAuthority: libkungfu Fact kernel over the yijinjing Hana POD journal
roles.responsibility: bind the exact admitted state before and after a Profile action without treating a ref as Cut identity
requiredEvidence: logical object id and version root
exact Cut root and ref revision receipt
nonClaims: does not imply occurrence, authority, complete reality, or completion

roles.identity: Episode Profile logical object plus independently queryable Episode id and sealed content root
roles.sourceAuthority: Kungfu Episode manifest journal and sealed Episode evidence
roles.responsibility: preserve the bounded causal occurrence mapped by the Profile
requiredEvidence: seal or compensation receipt and retained bundle
nonClaims: does not imply authorization, success, or Pursuit completion

roles.identity: Pursuit Profile logical object and immutable version roots
roles.sourceAuthority: declared Kungfu Profile intent source such as native Mission and Go facts
roles.responsibility: preserve intended-change continuity and explicit success or termination conditions
nonClaims: does not grant authority or prove occurrence

roles.identity: Atlas Profile logical object and immutable version roots bound to a declared perspective and source cut
roles.sourceAuthority: Xinfa Atlas, Project Cut, or a declared runtime-query perspective
roles.responsibility: bind perspective, sources, scope, freshness, omissions, conflicts, and declared loss
requiredEvidence: freshness revision plus omission, conflict, and loss roots
nonClaims: does not claim complete reality or grant permission

roles.identity: Warrant Profile logical object and immutable version roots
roles.sourceAuthority: declared issuer, reviewed plan, and exact Profile authorization policy
roles.responsibility: bind bounded authority, allowed operations, exact target state, decay, attenuation, and revocation
requiredEvidence: allowed operations, target roots, validity revision, and residual constraints
nonClaims: does not prove occurrence, success, or transfer of residual responsibility

preconditions: all five role mappings and exact support roots are supplied
transitions.effect: append five independently queryable Profile objects and CAS one named ref
evidence: five object and version receipts, relation roots, Cut root, and ref-CAS receipt

preconditions: exact basis Cut and expected ref revision remain current
transitions.effect: append an immutable successor version and advance the named ref
evidence: parent version, successor Cut, and ref-CAS receipt
residualRisks: successor admission does not prove external truth

preconditions: source Cut is exact and destination ref expects null revision zero
transitions.effect: create a distinct ref without moving the source ref
evidence: source basis and destination fork receipt
residualRisks: forks may later conflict and require explicit merge policy

preconditions: Episode id and seal evidence are independently inspectable
transitions.effect: map a sealed bounded occurrence into the successor Profile Cut
evidence: Episode manifest and sealed content root
residualRisks: contracted exports may omit raw evidence with declared loss

preconditions: the original Episode remains immutable and referenced
transitions.effect: append a compensation mapping without rewriting occurrence history
residualRisks: compensation may not reverse every external consequence

preconditions: current Atlas and unexpired scoped Warrant cover the action
evidence: Pursuit version ancestry and exact basis Cut
residualRisks: continuation does not imply eventual completion

preconditions: completion evidence is separately reviewed against success conditions
transitions.effect: append a completion state without inferring it from command success
evidence: completion claim, independent review, and consequence evidence
residualRisks: release or public claims may require additional gates

preconditions: abandonment authority and residual obligations are explicit
transitions.effect: terminate intent continuity without deleting prior Episodes or Facts
residualRisks: external consequences and cleanup can remain

preconditions: new sources, perspective, freshness revision, omissions, and loss are declared
transitions.effect: append a successor Atlas mapping without rewriting the stale version
evidence: old and new Atlas version roots plus source evidence
residualRisks: declared sources may still be incomplete

preconditions: freshness or source invalidation is retained
transitions.effect: make unsupported action fail visibly until refresh
residualRisks: some consumers may retain older projections

preconditions: new scope is a strict subset and issuer derivation remains explicit
evidence: old and new scopes and validity revisions
residualRisks: external systems may enforce a different capability boundary

preconditions: declared validity revision has ended or issuer explicitly expires it
transitions.effect: deny later actions under this Warrant
residualRisks: expiry does not undo actions already admitted

preconditions: issuer or delegated revoker is explicitly authorized
transitions.effect: deny later actions without deleting grant history
residualRisks: revocation does not prove remote side-effect cancellation

preconditions: denial reason and exact requested operation are retained
transitions.effect: append a queryable denial instead of silently omitting authority
evidence: requested operation, denial code, and basis Cut
residualRisks: a denied operation may be re-requested under a successor Warrant

native cross-platform fault evidence remains a release gate
installed distribution and cross-version bundle compatibility remain separate release gates
cross-machine consensus is outside the embedded two-provider witness
multi-process stress and compensation dogfood remain
issuer diversity and remote enforcement are outside this witness
independent completion review remains a final qualification gate
real Episode replay and contraction evidence is pending
installed-artifact parity remains a release qualification gate

nonClaims: This provisional Kungfu Product Profile does not activate or adopt KFD-7.
Profile states are product vocabulary rather than universal KFD enums.
Runtime unit evidence is not a release qualification or authority cutover.

activation.residualRisk: Episode replay, lifecycle breadth, role-minimality, independent product adoption, installed-artifact parity, and independent review are not yet complete.
